entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. A VeloBand.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and the order number?
Mark Sterling. Order is VF88602.

Thank you, Mr. Sterling. I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse, delivered on December 30th. To best help you, can I ask what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's not broken. I just don't want it.

I see. Okay, looking at the delivery date of December 30th, we are on day 12. The VeloBand Pulse has a specific 10-day return window due to hygiene protocols and how the device activates to a user's account. I'm afraid we are just outside that period.
Of course. So I'm just supposed to throw it away? Great.

I understand your frustration, and I apologize if the policy wasn't clear. I do need to ask, just for our records, was there a particular reason you weren't able to reach out to us within those first 10 days?
Yeah. I had a medical emergency. I was in the hospital for an unexpected surgery and just got home yesterday.
Oh, I am so very sorry to hear that. I truly hope you are on the road to a speedy recovery. Please, allow me just one moment to see what I can do.
Whatever.

(sound of typing) ... Thank you for your patience, Mr. Sterling. I've reviewed the situation, and given the circumstances with the medical emergency, we are absolutely able to make a one-time exception. I can process a full refund back to your original payment method for you.
Fine. That works.

Excellent. I have initiated that refund for you now. You should see it back in your account within 3-5 business days. And because you are a VIP member and for the trouble this has caused during a difficult time, I've also gone ahead and added a $50 credit to your VeloFit account for any future purchase. There's no expiry on that.
Okay. Thanks.
You are most welcome. I'll email you a confirmation of the refund and the credit right now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mr. Sterling?
No, that's it.
Alright. Well, I wish you all the best in your recovery. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
